items.title_orig: Fictional food you'd be willing to try?
items.article_text:
As the title states, what're some foods in stories you'd probably be willing to eat in real life, if only for curiosity's sake?
 Donkey Kong Bananza has multiple examples surprisingly enough. For one, there's the Bannadium Gems that DK eats throughout the game. Despite being minerals, they're actually edible, and taste like bananas. Then there's all the sweet treats in the Freezer Layer, ranging from ice cream, shaved ice, to all the lava in the level actually being melted chocolate. One of the prominent features of the Resort Layer is all of the giant fruit everywhere, with the standout being the giant watermelon above the sinkhole.
